newsitem.title: JAPAN: Key 182nd JGB yield falls to record low 2.250 pct.
newsitem.headline: Key 182nd JGB yield falls to record low 2.250 pct.

text.p: The yield of the benchmark cash 182nd 10-year Japanese government bond (JGB) fell to a record-low 2.250 percent in Thursday afternoon trade in Tokyo.
Earlier in the morning, the yield broke below a previous record low of 2.290 percent set on Wednesday.
The yield closed at 2.300 percent on Wednesday.
Traders said investors, including some life insurers, were detected buying.
